reason: The README describes a plugin that reformats Markdown tables in assistant replies and provides a command to replace the model-visible conversation with a placeholder, making document processing its primary purpose.

summaries.zh: 在每轮对话结束后自动对齐助手回复中的 Markdown 表格，并提供清除模型可见对话记录的命令。
summaries.en: Automatically aligns Markdown tables in assistant replies after each turn and provides a command to clear the model-visible conversation history.

capabilities: Automatically reformats Markdown tables in assistant replies after each turn
Replaces the model-visible conversation with a placeholder through /clear-history while retaining the append-only log
Uses surface replacement to modify displayed conversation content
